caption:
India's economy just grew faster than the central bank expected. 7.8%, against a 7% forecast.

India's real GDP grew 7.8% in Q1 FY27 (April-June 2026), beating the RBI's own 7% forecast and up from 6.9% a year earlier. Real gross value added grew 8.2%, investment rose 11.9%, and exports rose 12% - all outpacing the headline number. Nominal GDP reached Rs 81.36 lakh crore, up from Rs 75.46 lakh crore the same quarter last year.

A forecast is a guess about where the economy is headed. This quarter, the economy beat it.

Sources: IBEF, Outlook Business, citing MoSPI data (2026)
